metric_definitions.recall: Macro Source Recall over 23 validation queries with nonempty relevant Gold; each query weight one
metric_definitions.required_coverage: Mean Required Source coverage over 22 applicable queries; source presence alone is not a verified business fact
metric_definitions.precision_at_3: Unique relevant sources in returned top3 divided by fixed 3; mean over nonempty-Gold queries
metric_definitions.precision_returned_macro: Mean per-query returned precision over nonempty returned sets, including false hits on empty-Gold negatives; empty returned sets excluded
metric_definitions.precision_returned_micro: Total relevant returned sources / total returned sources; supplementary count, not used to select threshold
metric_definitions.chunk_document_source: All 28 short sources have exactly one document/chunk, so these levels are numerically equal in this controlled Dev. Not evidence for long-document behavior

scope_boundary: Native-dimension trusted PG research probe. Existing 512-dim production MCP only used for read-only historical diagnosis; no production MCP adapter for M3/Qwen3 implemented or claimed.
limitations: Small authored nonblind synthetic Dev: four distinct positive topics per split; not 56 independent business tasks or a sealed Holdout
Generic absent-source and security control questions repeat across splits; no independent generalization estimate for 0/3 negative false hits
No multilingual long documents, ANN, sparse/ColBERT, reranker, GPU or Agent/Report E2E measured
Calibration fitted query-score threshold; goal gating measured as a diagnostic, not a separately validated replacement goal policy
OS file cache and model order fixed, background workloads and low free RAM uncontrolled; baseline ONNX versus candidates PyTorch is a backend confound
Warm query latency and startup latency must be separated; do not claim Qwen faster from its shorter total process time
Historical English question never encoded by candidate models or used for calibration; its successful completion remains unproven
No production runtime/permission changes or historical DB writes; only a fresh Dev database/schema initialized with scoped local grants
next_minimal_plan: Choose one candidate profile and an independent next Dev to confirm relevance/required coverage and false positives; keep current default until approved
Add a new migration/model-manifest and citation compatibility version for native 1024 dimensions while retaining 512 legacy indexes and old Run bindings
Bind per-model search/goal policies and thresholds from trusted host; preserve Required/Supplement, fact/citation verification, P3, scope, Durable and budgets
Reuse existing MCP cache/prewarm mechanisms and validate cold-load timeouts, cancellation and recovery before deciding whether longer-lived inference is necessary
Only after separate engineering acceptance consider newly authorized bounded Live; no old Holdout/Permit reuse
